propositions: recheck-review refuses any current-revision finding state, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks, even though the remedy for attestation findings is ticket-side (earning the attestation via review-plan), not a code change

a no-code-change patchset copies the -1 label forward via the copy condition, so re-pushing the same tree does not clear a stale bugfix-size-attestation block after the ticket earns a valid plan-review attestation

recheck-review should accept a bugfix-size-attestation-only block when the ticket carries a current (accepted-bucket) plan-review attestation, by reading the bot's own vote message and re-classifying via the gate's privileged verifier

acceptance must require the block header count to be exactly 1, the single rendered criterion to be bugfix-size-attestation, the ticket id to resolve from the commit message (not the finding text), and the attestation to bucket as accepted
any block containing bugfix-size-attestation plus other findings, or an attestation in a flag/infra verdict, must still refuse; refusal must name the verdict and every parse failure must fail-closed
